name: Baldur's Gate 3 Enemies
author: Claude Play
description: Adds Baldur's Gate 3 themed enemies and 14 custom encounters across all three acts: the Owlbear elite and Minthara (act 1 boss), Yurg / Balthazar elites plus Ketheric Thorm and the Myrkul Apostle (act 2), and the Viconia / Cazador / Ansur elites plus Orin / Gortash / Raphael / Emperor bosses (act 3). Features 26 monsters with unique art, an original "Interact" mechanic with 2 exclusive relics, 14 original BGM tracks, and full Chinese + English localization. Requires BaseLib.
